# Replay traces

Sensor traces replayed by `:tools:replay` (format: `docs/adr/0004-replay-trace-format.md`).
Each file is gzip-compressed JSON Lines: a `trace_header` line, then one `Sample` or `SensorEvent`
per line in delivery order. Read one with `gzcat <file> | head`.

## Synthetic traces

Generated by `SyntheticTraces` (`tools/replay/src/main/kotlin/.../SyntheticTraces.kt`). Do not edit
them by hand: change the generator and run

```
./gradlew :tools:replay:generateSyntheticTraces
```

`SyntheticTraceReplayTest` fails when a committed file differs from the generator.

Every synthetic trace has, once per second, wrist heart rate, location (a 2 km loop), distance,
speed and cadence from `watch:health-services`, and chest strap heart rate from
`ble:C0:FF:EE:00:00:01` 250 ms later while the strap streams.

| File | Duration | Scenario | Samples |
|---|---|---|---|
| `easy-run-30min.jsonl.gz` | 30 min | Easy run at about 6:00/km, no dropouts | 10 800 |
| `intervals-6x3min.jsonl.gz` | 45 min | 10 min warm-up, 6 × (3 min at 4:00/km + 2 min jog at 6:30/km), 5 min cool-down | 16 200 |
| `strap-dropout.jsonl.gz` | 20 min | Strap silent 8:00–8:30 (connected, no data), disconnected 12:00–12:45 (GATT status 8), 0 bpm 16:40–16:45; wrist HR throughout | 7 125 |

## Field traces

A trace recorded on the watch ("Record debug trace", issue #20) that shows a bug goes here with a
name like `YYYY-MM-DD-<short-description>.jsonl.gz`, together with a failing test and a row in the
failure catalogue of `docs/RELIABILITY.md`. Field traces are never regenerated or edited. A trace
whose recording was cut short is still readable: `Trace.truncated` is set and every complete
record is kept.
